title: Strengthen SRD audit command to catch boundary and coverage failures
description:
Problem
The audit bundle's built-in suspicious-record checks reported 0 suspicious records even though the manual audit found clear parser failures.

Evidence from the 2026-06-07 audit
Missed failures include:
- Class proficiency fields containing class table rows and feature prose.
- Feature records containing Weapons/Tools/Saving Throws/Skills setup blocks.
- Subclass features swallowing adjacent features.
- Ancestry Languages line wraps becoming fake trait names.
- Missing Orb of Dragonkind magic item.
- Broad unrepresented source sections and tables.

Required behavior
- Extend audit tooling with structure-aware checks that catch these failure modes.
- The audit should produce actionable findings, not merely generic counts.
- Checks should be deterministic and suitable for local verification.

Acceptance criteria
- Add suspicious-pattern checks for table-row bleed in class proficiency fields.
- Add checks for class setup labels inside feature bodies.
- Add checks for swallowed adjacent feature headings.
- Add ancestry checks for bogus Languages-derived trait names.
- Add heading coverage checks for magic items, class/subclass features, ancestry traits, and key rule/table sections.
- Add tests proving the new audit checks fail against representative bad fixtures and pass against corrected output.
notes: PR #172 updated (commit 498ecb5): coverage now keyed on a SOURCE-coverage layer (packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sourceCoverage.ts) = emitted EXPECTED_* baseline + curated known source gaps (SRD_5_1_SOURCE_*_GAPS), deduped. Magic-item gap includes Orb of Dragonkind. Bundle feeds SOURCE_* lists into auditSrd for magic-item/table/rule (creature/ancestry stay on exact emitted gates). Verified: against committed pack the source-coverage audit reports exactly 1 missing magic item (Orb of Dragonkind). 6 new tests added (25 total in srdStructureAudit). Importer fix for Orb stays eshyra-0m9.16. typecheck/check/test all green (1289 passed).
close_reason: Merged to main via PR #172 (squash e8e3e8b). Adds structure-aware SRD audit (auditSrdStructure/auditSrdCoverage/auditSrd in packages/core/src/rules/srdAudit.ts) covering class-proficiency-bleed, feature-setup-label-bleed, swallowed-feature-heading, ancestry-bogus-trait, and missing-coverage; plus a SOURCE-coverage expectation layer (scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sourceCoverage.ts) so the audit catches the Orb of Dragonkind omission that the importer's emitted EXPECTED_* lists could not. Wired into the dnd5e-srd audit bundle. 25 tests. CodeQL ReDoS in slug() fixed. All CI green. Importer fix for Orb of Dragonkind remains eshyra-0m9.16.
